hops.note: UBI-245 token method applied against a genuinely empty categories.json (real classification: 0 clean, 0 ambiguous, 444 no-signal, reported before authoring anything). Real signal used: Cloudflare's own 551 human-authored OpenAPI tags, the same signal namespace_from_tags already uses for wire grouping. 426 of 444 tokens normalized directly from real tag text; 18 carried an internal non-human tag and were individually traced to real wire types/paths, collapsing onto 9 real Cloudflare products. Real result: 433 distinct category labels for 1088 wire types, 100% coverage verified both by direct computation and a real ubx-docs-providers sidebar build against a local mirror. Not forced coarser than the real product taxonomy warrants. One key (cloudflare_location) later removed once the wire-type set itself changed -- see write-intros hop's own notes.

Real wire-type set is 233 resources + 823 data sources (1056 total) -- two ubx-provider-dynamic create-binding fixes landed since categories was authored (see sdk/providers/.onboarding/cloudflare.json in ubiquex for the full account), dropping 268 -> 233 real resources. categories.json's own coverage re-verified against the new set: 966 of 967 keys still needed (cloudflare_location, which never had a real create OR real data source once both fixes landed, removed).

DONE: all 1056 real wire types have a real intro, verified by direct set-difference against the authoritative dump-ir wire-type list -- zero missing, zero stale keys. 16 batches (commits 70de50c/0e1fbbb/c49d2f5/95f1fbb for resources, 12 more for data sources), PRs #6-#17.

DONE: all 2178 real depth-0 field description gaps closed, verified via a live coverage_check.py run reporting 0 gaps across 233 resources, 823 data sources, 5898 depth-0 fields. Two canonical passes (39 generic envelope/pagination/identifier/time-range fields confirmed context-independent across every real occurrence before applying, covering 1328 of the 2178) followed by three per-resource batches (850 fields, real domain-specific text read against each field's own name and the resource's own already-established identity). PRs #18-#22, 5 batches, none merged yet.

Real tool bug found and fixed along the way: descriptions.json must use a FLAT "wire.field" key format (matching DigitalOcean's own published file, confirmed as the authoritative shape) -- a first attempt using a nested {wire: {field: text}} shape silently produced zero coverage change, since coverage_check.py's own lookup never matches that shape. Caught by re-running coverage_check.py immediately after writing rather than assuming the write worked.

All 22 PRs (#1-#22) stacked cleanly on ubx-sdk-cloudflare, none self-merged. Found and filed as its own ticket (UBI-246, not fixed here -- out of this session's own scope) a real, recurring ubx-provider-dynamic defect surfaced while authoring: multiple response schemas that legitimately resolve to the identical real create endpoint get independent, unrelated generated names instead of one collapsed/disambiguated name. Complete examples: AI Gateway (POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/gateways) has 10 generated names; Artifacts repository (POST .../artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos) has 3.

Hop complete: a live recompute reports zero gaps for cloudflare.
